title: Shapiro spikes in driven quantum fluids
abstract: Periodic driving of a Josephson junction produces resonant transport signatures known as Shapiro spikes, conventionally described by effective circuit models. Here, we demonstrate Shapiro spikes in a neutral quantum fluid using simulations of a potential-biased atomic Josephson junction. The dc-current resonances follow the expected Bessel-function scaling, including the suppression and revival of individual resonances with increasing modulation strength. We uncover their microscopic mechanism by showing that the phase-winding frequency develops finite plateaus at integer multiples of the drive frequency. These phase-locked states are sustained by quantized-vortex nucleation and the associated $2\pi$ phase slips. Remarkably, within a locking plateau, the dc current and density transfer can reverse direction while the phase-winding frequency remains locked to the drive, giving rise to negative-mobility transport. Our results establish a microscopic link between vortex-mediated phase slips, Shapiro resonances, and anomalous transport in a neutral quantum fluid, revealing how quantized vortices convert resonant transport into phase-locked dynamics with negative mobility.
summary:
1. 为揭示中性超流中势偏置共振输运的微观机制，作者以半经典场模拟二维原子约瑟夫森结，在固定势垒下施加直流与交流能量偏置。
2. 色散型电流共振遵循贝塞尔标度，涡旋介导的2π相位滑移维持整数倍驱动频率的锁相平台，而平台内非对称的周期内相位演化可使净流逆直流偏置而行，产生负迁移率。
3. 联合测量电流、相位与涡旋可检验这一同步机制，但锁相及负迁移率目前仅获半经典模拟支持。

title: Resonantly interacting $2e/3$ anyons: a controlled microscopic theory of anyon superconductivity
abstract: We develop a microscopic theory of anyon superconductivity that connects electronic interactions in a lightly doped Laughlin state to the universal physics of a resonantly interacting anyon gas. Using geometric quantization of Laughlin quasiholes, we derive the effective many-body Hamiltonian of dilute charge-$2e/3$ anyons, including their valley structure, dispersion, and statistical and short-range interactions, together with an explicit map between anyon and electron observables. This reduces the dilute many-body problem to a few parameters fixed by data computable from few anyon numerics. In analogy with resonant Fermi and Bose gases, we organize the dilute anyon problem around a two-body binding resonance and its relevant and marginal perturbations. For a three-valley gas of charge-$2e/3$ anyons, we identify a resonance whose long-distance theory is governed by an Aharonov-Casher anyon Hamiltonian whose magnetic field is the statistical Chern-Simons field and whose ground state is exactly solvable. Using the ground state wavefunction, we demonstrate Cooper-pair off-diagonal long-range order directly in electron coordinates and determine the pairing symmetry and vortex-lattice structure. The leading perturbations at the fixed point are a relevant pair detuning and a marginal three-body contact in the valley-singlet channel, which determine the compressibility and sound velocity. A repulsive three-body coupling is marginally irrelevant, allowing the fixed point to control a parametrically broad dilute regime near pair resonance, while attractive three-body interactions instead generate charge-$2e$ trimers. More broadly, our results show that binding thresholds between competing anyon composites host universal resonant regimes that are not captured by the lowest-energy anyon species alone, providing a new setting for controlled theories of anyon matter.
summary:
1. 为研究轻掺杂Laughlin态的任意子超导，作者用准空穴几何量子化推导电荷2e/3任意子的有效哈密顿量，并建立电子观测量映射。
2. 三谷气体在双体束缚共振处具有精确可解的长程理论基态，作者由此在电子坐标中证明库珀对非对角长程序，并确定配对对称性与涡旋晶格结构。
3. 三体排斥的边缘无关性使固定点可控制共振附近的宽广稀薄区间，而三体吸引产生电荷2e的三聚体，提示复合物束缚阈值可提供受控任意子理论的新途径。

title: Bypass Transition via the Non-Hermitian Skin Effect
abstract: Non-Hermitian skin lattices can directionally amplify propagating signals. Here we show that this amplification and nonlinear feedback together drive a bypass transition to self-sustained motion, familiar from shear flows. A finite local excitation can trigger sustained periodic or chaotic motion while the resting state remains linearly stable. We develop a return-map theory that predicts the triggering threshold, its scaling with directional gain, and the instability governing near-critical dynamics. The threshold decreases exponentially with chain length. Weak noise triggers sustained motion as well, with a characteristic ignition length that grows logarithmically as noise weakens at fixed observation time. Our work establishes a skin-effect route to bypass transitions, opening a new avenue for predicting and controlling nonlinear wave dynamics.
summary:
1. 作者在趋肤方向相反、由强度依赖转换耦合的非厄米双开链中，结合数值模拟与返回映射，研究瞬态放大如何经非线性反馈产生自持运动。
2. 在定向放大区内，有限局域激发可在静止态线性稳定时触发周期或混沌运动，振幅阈值随链长指数降低，主导标度为定向增益的−3/2次幂。
3. 这一理论机制有望在有源电路中检验，但残余线性耦合可使足够长的链先发生线性失稳，从而限制旁路转变的适用长度。

title: Medial Model of Elastic Curve Contacts, from Clasps to Knits
abstract: Materials constructed from interlocking and tangled fibers are challenging to model and understand due in part to the complex interplay between fiber shape and contact mechanics. Much of our intuition about contact mechanics comes from the Hertzian description, which is based on interactions between convex bodies. However, fibers often form clasp shapes, which involve saddle-shaped contact surfaces; the ability for two interacting bodies to conform to each other along a saddle surface confounds many existing mechanical contact models. Following an observation that contact surfaces between fibers tend to look like minimal, constant mean-curvature surfaces, we seek to test this hypothesis and provide a direct link to geometric modeling methods. To do this, we leverage the medial axis transformation, which generalizes the notion of a Voronoi tessellation to generating curves and surfaces. Through computational studies on an orthogonal clasp and a simple knit structure, we find that the medial axis transformation provides a reasonable model for contact surfaces between identical curves. We also show that a generalization of the medial axis transformation based on radical Voronoi tessellations can be used to well-approximate contact surfaces between non-identical curves. We apply this ``radical axis transform'' to curves of different radii and demonstrate a trend for surfaces to adopt finite mean curvature. Our results may point the way towards more sophisticated geometric methods for modeling tangles.
summary:
1. 针对纤维鞍形接触面能否视为极小曲面，作者结合离散弹性杆、幂律接触势与中轴变换，模拟正交扣结及平针织物。
2. 高对称接触区仅局部接近零平均曲率，半径差异引入非零平均曲率，而经有效半径修正的加权沃罗诺伊构造比普通中轴更贴近模型接触点。
3. 该几何近似可用于研究载荷与纤维不对称性对接触面的影响，但仍需实验和有限元验证，并检验其对本构关系的依赖。

title: Exact Mirror-Parity Selection Rule for Electron-Phonon Coupling in Two-Dimensional Crystals
abstract:
The electron--phonon (e-ph) interaction underlies conventional superconductivity and plays a central role in transport and other many-body phenomena in solids. Here, we derive a symmetry selection rule for e-ph scattering in two-dimensional crystals possessing a horizontal mirror plane, $\sigma_h$. For electronic states of mirror parity $s_n(\mathbf{k})$ and $s_m(\mathbf{k}+\mathbf{q})$, and a phonon mode of parity $\chi_
u(\mathbf{q})$, we show that the e-ph matrix element $g_{mn,
u}(\mathbf{k},\mathbf{q})$ vanishes identically unless $s_n(\mathbf{k})\,\chi_
u(\mathbf{q})\, s_m(\mathbf{k}+\mathbf{q})=+1$. The rule follows from the covariance of the phonon-induced deformation potential under $\sigma_h$, constitutes the $C_s$ case of the general group-theoretical selection rule for matrix elements, and partitions the e-ph interaction throughout the Brillouin zone into symmetry-allowed and symmetry-forbidden scattering channels. Consequently, mirror-even phonons couple electronic states of the same mirror parity, either even--even or odd--odd, whereas mirror-odd phonons couple only states of opposite mirror parity, for both intra- and interband processes. We illustrate the selection rule through first-principles calculations for the two-dimensional superconductor $\mathrm{Sc_2BCH_4}$, where mirror parity is well defined throughout the entire Brillouin zone and symmetry-forbidden matrix elements vanish up to numerical precision. We then extend the analysis to bulk $\mathrm{MgB_2}$, where the rule applies exactly only on mirror-invariant planes of the three-dimensional Brillouin zone. Moving away from these planes removes the exact mirror constraint and activates scattering channels that are symmetry forbidden when the mirror eigenvalues are well defined. Our results establish horizontal mirror symmetry as an exact and practical filter of e-ph scattering processes.
summary:
1. 为厘清水平镜面对二维晶体线性电声耦合的约束，作者从形变势协变性推导选择定则，并以直接密度泛函微扰计算检验假想Sc₂BCH₄单层与块体MgB₂。
2. 偶、奇声子在二维全布里渊区分别仅允许同、异镜面宇称电子态耦合，单层示例中禁戒矩阵元模平方比主导允许项低约八个数量级。
3. 该定则可筛除对称性强制的零耦合，却不决定允许项强度；在三维MgB₂中，仅当参与波矢均处于镜面不变子空间时严格成立，偏离后原禁戒通道被激活。

title: Topological localization in unentangled random braids
abstract: In 2015, P. Serna, G. Bunin, and A. Nahum numerically investigated fluctuations in a bunch of unentangled random threads. They showed that fluctuations of an individual thread in a braid are qualitatively different from those of a thread embedded in a medium of fixed parallel lines. In particular, Serna et al. observed a logarithmic increase in the average transverse span, $\left<|x_N|\right>$, of a thread with polymer length, $N$. This behavior highlights the collective nature of topological interactions, in which each polymer fluctuates and constrains the motion of the others. Studying this problem both numerically and analytically, we propose the following interpretation: the logarithmic regime is transient, and sufficiently long polymers exhibit topological localization, where $\left<|x_N|\right>$ approaches a finite limit at $N\to\infty$. Unlike localization induced by quenched external disorder, this phenomenon arises solely from collective topological constraints. We study braids within a locally free approximation and support the localization by analytical investigation of Brownian bridges on the asymptotic Cayley graph of a locally free group. We further conjecture that topologically induced localization emerges as a phase transition: for a small number of threads, $n \sim 2÷5$, the span, $\left<|x_N|\right>$, grows algebraically, with the usual scaling $\left<|x_N|\right>\sim N^{1/4}$ at $N\gg 1$; by contrast, for sufficiently large $n$, each thread in a long braid ($N\gg 1$) asymptotically localizes, approaching $\left<|x_N|\right>\sim \mathrm{const}$.
summary:
1. 为判定无纠缠定向聚合物束的横向涨落是否最终饱和，作者结合局部自由群近似下的蒙特卡洛模拟与有效树图上的布朗桥分析。
2. 链长至1200的模拟显示多链中点涨落呈饱和趋势，而均匀固定障碍中仍近似按N的1/4次方增长，理论以集体拓扑约束形成的熵陷阱解释这一差别。
3. 结果支持将既有对数增长解释为暂态，但受有限链长、缓慢弛豫和群近似限制，链数驱动的局域化相变及完整编织群中的渐近行为仍待验证。

title: Shock-driven Jetting at HMX Crystal Surface Asperities
abstract: Shock-induced jetting and recompression are plausible mechanisms for hot spot formation in energetic materials, but remain poorly understood. To this end, we apply all-atom nonreactive molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of a shock-loaded sinusoidal surface asperity in the crystalline explosive HMX (octahydro-1,3,5,7-tetranitro-1,3,5,7-tetrazocine) to quantify the roles of shock strength, asperity geometry, system size, and crystallographic orientation in determining the jetting response. Our simulations span a shock pressure interval of $\approx$4-47 GPa, which captures responses in both detonation initiation and steady-state detonation regimes. We find that shock strength and asperity curvature exert strong influence on jet velocity, temperature, and morphology, while feature size and crystallographic orientation play more modest roles. Jet morphology correlates strongly with the HMX ambient-pressure phase diagram and the narrow temperature range associated with its liquid phase. Coherent jets form when focusing and dissipation are sufficient to drive local temperatures above the melting point, while formation of molecular plumes is seemingly connected to jet temperatures exceeding the liquid-vapor transition temperature. Formation of plumes is unlike the jetting responses seen in metals, which typically exhibit liquid phases that are stable over wider temperature intervals. This work proposes a simple hypothesis for the connection between jet morphology and ambient-pressure phase diagrams that can be readily tested in other explosives and metals. It also provides a foundation for ongoing nonreactive and reactive MD simulations of jet impact and recompression to quantify the role played by jets in forming hot spots in HMX-based explosives.
summary:
1. 为厘清炸药晶体的表面射流机制，作者以全原子非反应分子动力学模拟HMX正弦起伏表面，考察冲击强度、几何、尺寸与晶向的影响。
2. 起伏纵横比kh₀≈3时，约11 GPa观察到射流，26 GPa及以上出现分子羽流，形貌转变与局部温度跨越常压熔化、汽化边界相关，并受几何聚焦显著调节。
3. 相图与射流形貌的关联可在其他材料中检验，但本研究未涉及再压缩和化学反应，尚不能确定射流对热点形成的贡献。

title: Analytic two-body density-matrix spectrum of the Fermionic Tonks-Girardeau gas
abstract: The two-body density matrix (TBDM) of a quantum many-body system provides information about particle correlations, e.g., pairing. In this work, we derive the complete spectrum of the TBDM of the fermionic Tonks-Girardeau gas using its exact ground-state wavefunction in second quantization. We obtain analytical expressions for all eigenvalues and eigenvectors for an arbitrary number of particles and identify two different types of eigenstates: collective states, formed by superpositions of paired momentum modes, and single-determinant states. We provide a physical interpretation of this structure, explaining the origin of the different eigenstates and their degeneracies. We further derive an asymptotic expansion for the largest eigenvalue, improving on previous estimates and analytically confirming its linear scaling with the particle number, thereby indicating off-diagonal long-range order. For the high-index collective states, we obtain simpler expressions for the eigenvalues and eigenvectors, showing that the eigenvalues decay as $n^{-4}$ and that the eigenvectors become independent of the number of particles. Finally, we discuss the connection between the collective states and an effective description in terms of composite bosons, whose spectral properties suggest a behavior consistent with Tan's contact for interacting bosonic systems.
summary:
1. 为揭示一维费米Tonks–Girardeau气体的配对关联，作者利用精确基态的二次量子化表示，推导任意粒子数的两体密度矩阵全谱。
2. 谱分为非简并集体态与简并单行列式态，最大本征值渐近为N/4+3/16+O(N⁻¹)，改进既有估计并解析确证非对角长程有序。
3. 高序号集体谱的n⁻⁴衰减提示复合玻色子可能具有有效接触相互作用，但费米对空间离域，将其视为单个粒子的解释仍待验证。

title: Ferroelectricity and Peierls transition in MOI$_2$ (M=Ta, Nb): a first-principle analysis
abstract: The van der Waals ferroelectric NbOI$_2$ hosts a polar distortion that is commonly attributed to the Peierls dimerization of its Nb chains. Here we show, using first-principles calculations and a Landau-type energy, that the polar instability is in fact a distinct order parameter that does not stem from the Peierls mode condensation and that three main distinct modes are important in the whole MOI$_2$ family. They are a polar mode $P$, an antipolar mode $\eta$, and a Peierls mode $\delta$, whose stabilities and couplings strongly depend on the nature of the $M$ metal element, as evidenced by the fact that the isostructural, TaOI$_2$ system is not polar while possessing Peirls distortions.
summary:
1. 针对铁电性是否源于链二聚化，作者结合第一性原理声子、冻结模计算与朗道模型，重建NbOI₂和TaOI₂的四原子未二聚化参考母相。
2. 计算表明极性是独立序参量，三线性耦合被对称性禁止，区心反极性模源于晶胞加倍折叠；二聚化在NbOI₂中抑制极性，在TaOI₂中促进极性却不足以使极性模失稳。
3. Nb/Ta固溶有望调节二聚化与极性的耦合，但耦合过零的设想及符号反转的微观机制仍待验证。

title: Interplay between Spin Stripes and Pairing Crossover in the Bilayer Hubbard Model
abstract: Whether $d$-wave or $s_\pm$-wave pairing prevails in the bilayer nickelate \ce{La3Ni2O7} remains unresolved, and how its observed spin order and magnetic excitations relate to the pairing mechanism is unclear. Here, we use finite-temperature determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations of a minimal bilayer Hubbard model to investigate pairing competition at strong interlayer coupling, where intralayer and interlayer antiferromagnetic correlations have comparable strengths. We find that spin stripes develop spontaneously with increasing hole doping, accompanied by a crossover of the dominant pairing symmetry from $d$-wave to $s_\pm$-wave. The crossover tracks the changing relative strengths of the spin correlations, with the interlayer correlations overtaking their intralayer counterparts in magnitude. Concomitantly, the dynamical spin structure factor exhibits a momentum-dependent reorganization of the magnetic excitations, consistent with fluctuating spin stripes. Our results identify the structure of spin fluctuations as a key link between spin stripes and pairing competition, offering a minimal-model perspective for understanding \ce{La3Ni2O7}.
summary:
1. 针对自旋条纹与配对竞争的联系，作者用有限温行列式量子蒙特卡罗研究层间、层内跃迁相当的单轨道双层Hubbard模型。
2. 在空穴掺杂δ≈0.102—0.125，自旋反相畴出现，层间反铁磁关联反超层内关联，主导配对吸引由d波转为s±波，并伴随磁激发的动量依赖重组。
3. 结果为双层镍酸盐的磁性与配对关联提供最简模型参照，但尚未确定超导转变，材料解释仍需纳入多轨道与结构效应。

title: Neural Networks with Exciton-Polariton Waveguides
abstract: We propose and numerically study a scheme for neural networks using exciton-polariton waveguide meshes. These enable arbitrary programmable interlayer couplings suited to a restricted Boltzmann machine architecture where polariton phases act as stochastic network variables. We show that such a network can be trained using unsupervised Hebbian and anti-Hebbian updates. This allows the implementation of an associative memory, where the network recovers learned patterns from imperfect inputs.
summary:
1. 针对极化激元网络连接受限的问题，作者以随机增益饱和模型研究含辅助通道的波导网格，用凝聚相位构建层间全连接、权重可编程的受限玻尔兹曼机。
2. 数值结果显示，两层各45个节点经赫布与反赫布无监督训练，可从受噪声或相位翻转扰动的输入恢复十种数字模板，平均目标重叠度高于输入基线。
3. 该架构为可编程极化激元联想记忆提供候选路线，但目前仅经数值验证且权重离线更新，实验实现和扩展性仍待检验。

title: Floquet-Volkov spin polarization in spin-degenerate Antiferromagnets
abstract: Periodic driving enables ultrafast control of electronic structures in solids through the formation of photon-dressed Floquet-Bloch states. However, the measured photoemission spectra are influenced not only by these states but also by their interference with Volkov-dressed outgoing photoelectrons. Here, we demonstrate that Floquet-Volkov interference can generate spin-polarized photoemission in a collinear antiferromagnetic Dirac model without spin-orbit coupling (SOC). An in-plane linearly polarized pump preserves $\mathcal{PT}$ symmetry, leaving the Floquet quasienergies spin degenerate. Under near-resonant driving, photon-dressed conduction and valence bands hybridize, producing spin-dependent relative phases that are converted into unequal spin-resolved photoemission intensities through interference between pathways reaching the same Volkov-dressed final state. We analytically identify this interference mechanism and verify it using nonequilibrium Green-function calculations under periodic driving and finite pump-probe pulses. We further demonstrate that rotating the probe polarization can suppress or reverse the spin polarization without modifying the Floquet bands. Our findings establish Floquet-Volkov interference as a route to spin-selective photoemission in driven antiferromagnets without Floquet spin splitting or SOC.
summary:
1. 作者在无自旋轨道耦合的共线反铁磁狄拉克模型中，结合解析推导与非平衡格林函数模拟，研究周期及有限脉冲驱动下自旋简并态能否产生极化光电子。
2. 近共振带间杂化产生的自旋相关相位差经Floquet–Volkov干涉转化为光电子强度差，而能带保持自旋简并，旋转探测光偏振可消除或反转极化。
3. 该结果表明光电子极化未必意味着初态能带自旋劈裂，所提出的全内反射倏逝场方案为实验检验提供了路径，但实际材料中的实现仍待验证。

title: Temperature-Dependent Ion Dynamics in Argyrodite Superionic Conductor Li$_{6}$PS$_{5}$Cl with Fine-Tuned MACE Foundation Model
abstract: The rapid growth of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIP), particularly the foundational models for materials chemistry, such as MACE, has significantly strengthened our capabilities in studying the complex dynamics of materials through statistical sampling. Here, by performing molecular dynamics with a fine-tuned MACE model, that are further combined with essential dynamics analysis, a tool that is commonly applied in (bio)molecular simulations, we examine the temperature-dependent ion dynamics in a prototypical inorganic solid superionic conductor, namely argyrodite Li$_{6}$PS$_{5}$Cl. Our analyses show clear localised phonon-like dynamics for Li$^+$ ions below 500 K with trajectories lying in a low-dimensional manifold that is highly nonlinear, which is opposite to the case in the high-temperature ($\sim$800 K) end. Between 500-700 K, the system exhibit strong competition in the dynamics between the Li$^+$ and framework ions, that are reflected in both the eigenspectrum and the projected low-dimensional embeddings characterising these dynamics not showing a simple monotonic dependency upon rising temperatures, and is further supported by investigations employing Langevin dynamics that systematically examine how damping the framework motions affects the dynamics of the Li$^+$ ions, thanks to the computational efficiency provided by MLIP. This work thus contributes towards the broader theoretical and data-driven framework for studying the lattice dynamics of solids.
summary:
1. 为探明Li₆PS₅Cl中锂扩散与骨架振动的温度依赖耦合，作者以微调MACE势开展纳秒分子动力学，结合位移协方差、轨迹几何分析及骨架阻尼测试。
2. 从500升至600 K，解释半数锂位移涨落所需主模由约10个减至2个，700 K又增多，结合阻尼测试支持骨架与锂运动竞争的解释。
3. 该方法为统一研究局域振动与扩散提供路径，但模型仍存在低温氯离子零频谱异常，定量输运预测尚需验证。

title: Variational Monte Carlo Study of Superconductivity in a Correlated System with Broken Inversion Symmetry
abstract: Unconventional superconductivity in systems with broken inversion symmetry has attracted considerable interest because antisymmetric spin-orbit coupling (ASOC) can strongly affect the spin structure and stability of superconducting states. In this study, we investigate superconductivity in a correlated system with the symmetry of a honeycomb network using the variational Monte Carlo method. We consider a single-band Hubbard model including an on-site Coulomb interaction $U$ and ASOC with coupling strength $\lambda$, and compare several pairing states with different pairing symmetries. The trial wave functions are constructed from particle-number- and Gutzwiller-projected BCS states. To examine the energetic stability of each pairing state, we calculate the variational energy as a function of the gap amplitude, while optimizing the variational parameter $\mu$ and the Gutzwiller parameter $g$ for each gap amplitude. At $U/t = 10$, the $f$-wave state has the lowest variational energy for $\lambda/t = 0$, whereas the chiral $p$-wave state becomes the most energetically favorable for $\lambda/t = 0.1$. These results indicate that ASOC strongly affects the competition among superconducting pairing states in the presence of strong electron correlations.
summary:
1. 针对反对称自旋轨道耦合如何影响强关联配对竞争，作者在四分之一填充的三角晶格Hubbard模型中，以粒子数和Gutzwiller投影BCS态开展变分蒙特卡洛计算，比较四种配对态。
2. 在U/t=10的100格点体系中，λ/t=0和0.1时最低能试探态分别为f波和手性p波，后者比投影费米海低约5×10⁻⁵t，显示该耦合可重排配对竞争。
3. 计算未纳入单重态—三重态混合，有限体系的能量优势也尚不能确立超导长程序，仍需长程配对关联与尺寸标度检验。

title: Frank Elastic Constants of Associating Rigid-Rodlike Systems
abstract: Frank elastic constants of associating rigid rodlike systems are investigated using a mean field theory combined with the Straley elastic free energy formalism. The aggregation equilibrium and orientational ordering are treated self-consistently to analyze the concentration and temperature dependences of the elastic constants. Both a monomer--dimer model and a fully polydisperse rodlike aggregate model are considered. We find that aggregation selectively enhances the bend elastic constant through the long-tail structure of the aggregate-size distribution. As a result, a pronounced elastic anisotropy, $K_{33}\gg K_{11}>K_{22}$, emerges in the nematic phase. Decreasing temperature or increasing concentration promotes the formation of long rodlike aggregates and induces a rapid increase in the bend elastic constant, while the relation $K_{11}=3K_{22}$ remains unchanged. The exceptionally large bend elastic constants predicted here should be regarded as upper-bound estimates for the rigid-aggregate limit.
summary:
1. 针对可逆缔合如何改变向列相弹性，作者结合平均场与Straley理论，自洽计算单体—二聚体及多分散刚性棒模型的聚集平衡、取向有序和Frank常数。
2. 数值结果显示分布长尾中的长聚集体选择性增强弯曲弹性，高浓度下K₃₃近似随体积分数四次方增长，比非缔合体系的三次方更陡，而K₁₁=3K₂₂保持不变。
3. 该机制提示可通过温度与浓度调节弹性各向异性，但巨大弯曲模量应视为刚性极限下的上界估计，联系真实体系仍需纳入柔性与有限持久长度。

title: Symmetry-Selective Shift Current in Polar Multidomain Superlattices
abstract: Periodic polar multidomain superlattices can act as symmetry-selective elements for shift-current generation. We demonstrate this using a two-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with prescribed multidomain configurations. The distinct full-supercell symmetries of periodic head-to-head and head-to-tail arrangements impose different constraints on the shift-current tensor and thereby select complementary nonlinear-response channels, as confirmed by numerical calculations. A direct comparison with equal-area averages of the constituent single-domain spectra shows that an independent-domain average does not reproduce the detailed multidomain spectra. A bond-resolved contribution analysis further clarifies the real-space origin of the multidomain response. Widening each domain from one to ten primitive cells leaves the selection rules intact. On the photon-energy grid used here, the allowed head-to-tail response changes sign and grows by about an order of magnitude. These results provide a theoretical framework for the symmetry-based design of anisotropic optical rectification in polar multidomain superlattices.
summary:
1. 作者在预设极性的二维SSH超晶格中，结合对称性、二阶响应计算与键分解，研究头对头及头对尾畴排列如何选择位移电流通道。
2. 镜面与滑移对称性选择互补张量分量，等面积单畴平均不能复现窄畴响应谱；畴宽从1增至10个原胞时定则不变，头对尾主响应在采样网格上反号并增强约十倍。
3. 这为畴工程调控各向异性光整流提供理论思路，但尚非真实材料或器件的定量预测，也未提取孤立畴壁响应。

title: Thermodynamic signatures of the period-doubling route to chemical chaos
abstract: Chemical reaction networks can evolve from stable oscillations to chaos through successive period doublings. We investigate general properties of entropy-production fluctuations near the onset of chaos and within the chaotic regime in reversible, well-mixed reaction networks. Near an isolated supercritical period-doubling bifurcation, we find a one-sided divergence of the diffusion constant with exponent one. For chaotic attractors satisfying the stated conditions, the entropy variance per unit volume grows exponentially when the macroscopic limit is taken first. Its exponential growth rate is $2\lambda_{\max}$, where $\lambda_{\max}$ is the largest Lyapunov exponent, implying a divergent diffusion constant. We also discuss the volume dependence of the fluctuations and the underlying physical mechanisms.
summary:
1. 作者结合系统尺度展开、Floquet分析与朗之万模拟，研究均匀可逆化学网络中孤立超临界倍周期分岔及混沌的环境熵涨落。
2. 非退化条件下，熵扩散常数仅从倍周期侧以临界指数1发散；先取宏观极限且满足稳态与耦合条件时，单位体积条件方差的典型指数增长率为最大李雅普诺夫指数的两倍。
3. 有限体积下指数放大仅为暂态，两个模型支持长时方差率的体积平方标度，但其与确定性熵流相关函数的理论联系仍依赖极限可交换等假设。

title: A Construction Framework for Three-Dimensional Topological Magnetic Textures
abstract: Three-dimensional magnetic systems offer diverse possibilities for constructing complex topological textures from simpler magnetic configurations. Here, we present different routes for constructing complex three-dimensional magnetic textures from simpler parent configurations and discuss their impact on the topology of the resulting structures. We identify four construction principles: (i) adding transverse modulations, (ii) adding structures, (iii) entangling textures (e.g. braiding, or twisting), and (iv) introducing singularities. Using the skyrmion tube as an explicit parent configuration, we show how these principles give rise to several known three-dimensional magnetic textures. We then apply the same principles to predict novel textures derived from a meron tube, which are confirmed by micromagnetic simulations to be metastable in chiral magnets. Our results establish general principles for the systematic construction and discovery of complex three-dimensional magnetic textures.
summary:
1. 为厘清三维磁纹理的构造与拓扑关系，作者从斯格明子管和半斯格明子管出发，提出横向调制、添加结构、缠结及引入奇点四条路径。
2. 微磁模拟验证新预测的半斯格明子衍生纹理在交换与体DMI模型中亚稳，涌现磁通管的自链接和互链接则给出霍普夫指数的设计规则。
3. 该框架为搜索新磁态提供依据，但亚稳性仅在特定模型和边界下验证，含布洛赫点的纹理需另行拓扑分类。

title: Steady states in asymmetric exclusion processes with reactions: Fluctuations and non-mean field behaviour
abstract: We study an totally asymmetric simple exclusion process (TASEP) in an open geometry. We couple TASEP with simple reactions in the form of production (birth) and degradation (death) due to over crowding taking place in the bulk. We investigate the steady states, which are generically space-dependent. Phase coexistences are also possible for some choices of the model parameters. We study the system by mean-field theories (MFT) supplemented by extensive Monte-Carlo simulations (MCS). Intriguingly, unlike oridinary TASEP and other related models, configuration-dependent bulk reactions in a TASEP model can make nearest-neighbour correlations quantitatively important even in an open driven system where mean-field theory would ordinarily be expected to provide a useful description. We attribute this to the correlation effects ignored in MFT. We numerically quantify this correlation effect.
summary:
1. 作者用平均场与蒙特卡洛模拟研究开放一维全非对称简单排斥模型，考察邻位繁殖与成对湮灭如何改变稳态，重点分析生灭率相等的情形。
2. 模拟确认低、高密度相及其共存，并发现近邻占据对概率超过密度平方，支持反应诱导关联导致平均场高估稳态密度的解释。
3. 含配对关联的理论有望改善预测，但平均场预言的最大流相及其混合相尚未获模拟确认，密度偏差在热力学极限下是否持续仍待检验。

title: Mutual linearity in semi-Markov networks
abstract: Despite their microscopic complexity, stochastic networks show a surprising degree of universal, parameter-independent properties. One example is mutual linearity, which has recently been characterized as a generic, pairwise-linear relation between observables of Markov processes under local perturbations, valid for both stationary dynamics and for transient dynamics in Laplace space. Here we show that mutual linearity arises if a certain global affine relation is satisfied. This allows us to demonstrate that mutual linearity also holds for a broad class of local perturbations in semi-Markov networks, which, unlike Markov networks, have memory in terms of the dwell time in the current state. However, exceptions exist, meaning that mutual linearity does not extend to all possible perturbations of semi-Markov networks. Strikingly, this restriction disappears for first-passage times. Thus, semi-Markov networks exhibit a fundamental asymmetry between occupation and first-passage statistics, different from Markov networks. Finally, we show that our results are directly applicable to stochastic resetting in semi-Markov networks, where the Laplace-space relations acquire a physical interpretation in terms of stationary occupations and the probability to reach a target before reset. This provides a natural setting in which the predicted affine relations can be probed.
summary:
1. 针对驻留时间记忆能否保留局部扰动下的互线性，作者通过拉普拉斯域秩一矩阵求逆，推导半马尔可夫网络的全局仿射响应条件。
2. 在拉普拉斯域，占据概率互线性受扰动形式限制，而固定目标、不同初态的首达时间密度对任意单态扰动均保持互线性，20节点网络模拟支持这一不对称性。
3. 泊松重置将上述关系转化为稳态占据概率及重置前命中概率之间的关系，为实验检验提供了途径，但尚无实验验证。

title: Stability of energy gap of macroscopic quantum matter
abstract: In quantum many-body physics and quantum field theory, it is often assumed that gapped systems remain gapped under sufficiently weak local perturbations. However, to what extent this assumption holds is elusive, except for some special systems. In this work, we examine the stability of energy gap of macroscopic quantum matter that is only subject to two physically natural conditions, locality and translation invariance. We first show that in any spatial dimension, there are gapped local Hamiltonians with a unique ground state and an unstable gap, i.e., they become gapless under certain arbitrarily weak local perturbation in the thermodynamic limit. We then prove that for both spin and fermionic systems in one dimension, such Hamiltonians with an unstable gap must not only break translation invariance but also be fine-tuned. We further show that in any dimension greater than one, there are fine-tuned local translation invariant Hamiltonians with a unique ground state and an unstable gap. These results greatly sharpen our understanding of the fundamental problem of the stability of quantum phases of matter. We also discuss implications of our results on, for example, anyon superconductivity and higher-form symmetries.
summary:
1. 作者通过局域哈密顿量反例和理论证明，研究宏观量子物质的能隙对弱局域扰动的稳定性及平移不变性的作用。
2. 任意维度均有唯一基态模型在热力学极限下被某些任意弱局域扰动闭隙；一维自旋和费米反例须破坏平移不变性且经精细调节，高维精细调节反例则可保持平移不变。
3. 局域性与平移不变性因而不足以保证高维能隙稳定，但这些精细调节反例不意味着一般体系普遍不稳定。

title: Dynamically Reentrant Skyrmion Phase in Oscillating Magnetic Fields
abstract: We address a central open question in driven topological matter by investigating the nonequilibrium response of a two-dimensional magnet with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions subjected to a periodically oscillating magnetic field. Using extensive Monte Carlo simulations, we uncover a dynamically reentrant skyrmion phase that emerges within a finite window of field amplitudes and bias fields, sandwiched between the conventional skyrmion and polarized ferromagnetic phases. This phase has no equilibrium counterpart and originates from an imbalance between skyrmion creation and annihilation over a single field cycle, leading to a reversal of the period-averaged topological charge. We show that the re-entrant phase exists only in the dynamic response regime where the system can follow the drive, and is suppressed at higher driving frequencies. Our results establish periodic driving as a nonequilibrium control parameter for stabilizing and reversing skyrmion topology.
summary:
1. 为探究周期磁场如何改变斯格明子的集体拓扑响应，作者对含DMI的二维三角晶格海森堡磁体进行方波驱动蒙特卡洛模拟。
2. 在有限振幅与偏置窗口内，生成与湮灭失衡使周期平均拓扑荷反号并重入，半周期由100–200缩至20 MCSS时该响应受抑。
3. 周期平均拓扑荷有望成为实验检验该效应的信号，但模拟仅观察到无序纹理，尚未证实驱动下的斯格明子晶格。

title: Finite-width shift of the edge of chaos in deep neural networks
abstract: Deep neural networks train best when they are initialised at the edge of chaos, the critical line in the plane of weight and bias variances on which the distance between two inputs neither grows nor shrinks with depth. The line is known for infinitely wide networks; at finite width it moves, and how it moves has been disputed. We treat the logarithm of the distance between two inputs through a network of width $N$ as a random walk and compute its drift and variance to order $1/N$. The edge of chaos moves to a larger weight variance, by $\Delta\sigma_w^2=-a_1/(N\,\partial_{\sigma_w^2}\ln\chi_1)$, about $8/N$ for $\tanh$ networks at a bias variance of $0.05$, confirmed by simulations of the exact finite-width recursion. The shift describes a typical network; the average over many networks is dominated by rare networks in which the distance grows, and its critical point moves the other way, which explains why calculations and simulations have disagreed. Backpropagation follows the same random walk, so the shift applies to gradients unchanged. Along the edge of chaos, the information about the similarity of two inputs is constant until the compression over the depth exceeds about one nat, which fixes where to sit on the line. The results give an initialisation rule, Crinit, that places a network on its finite-width edge of chaos without a search. On MNIST and Fashion-MNIST at width $64$ it is more accurate than the standard rules at their usual settings, by a small margin in shallow networks and a large one in deep networks, where most standard rules fail; it trains in fewer steps, and it matches or beats the standard rules with a tuned gain.
summary:
1. 为确定有限宽度如何移动混沌边界，作者将宽度N的全连接深层网络中两输入平方距离的对数视为随机游走，计算其漂移和方差的1/N修正。
2. 精确递推模拟支持典型网络的临界权重方差上移，tanh网络在偏置方差0.05时约上移8/N，而受稀有样本支配的系综均值临界点反向移动。
3. 据此构建的初始化规则在两种小型图像数据集上改善了训练，但收益主要来自工作点与首层设置，临界理论向其他架构及训练动力学的推广仍待检验。

title: Explicit pore pre-conditioning and inverse design of amorphous nanoporous carbon
abstract: Porous carbons store energy, capture gases and purify water, and their performance depends strongly on the geometry of their pores. Atomistic models mostly simulate their synthesis by molecular dynamics, with results that depend on the interatomic potential, and return the pore network as an output rather than as a specification. Here we show that the pore network can be an input: pores drawn from a target size distribution fill a prescribed volume fraction, carbon is grown around them by stochastic ring placement, and a particle swarm recovers the construction parameters from a structural fingerprint. The search reproduces the density, surface area and pore volume of a carbon produced by quenched molecular dynamics within about 5 %, together with its pore size distribution. As a stress test, it also recovers a bimodal distribution, and the search history reveals which parameters the targets constrain and flags a failed search. A short anneal completes the network, recovering the coordination of the reference while the pore size distribution keeps its shape. Molecular dynamics still supplies the local chemistry, but the pore geometry becomes a design variable for a given application.
summary:
1. 为将纳米孔碳的孔径分布从模拟输出变为设计输入，作者结合预置孔洞、逐环生长、粒子群参数反演与分子动力学退火构建原子模型。
2. 退火前模型在约5%误差内重现淬火参照的密度、表面积和探针可占据孔体积，谐和构建还重现7与16 Å的双峰孔径分布。
3. 该方法为按需设计纯碳孔网络提供路径，但退火改善配位的同时会改变孔径，低于约4 Å的孔径难以控制，实验靶标仍待检验。

title: Cell-type-specific modularity in E/I networks shapes dynamical regimes and computational capabilities
abstract: Structural modularity is a ubiquitous feature of brain networks that shapes neural dynamics and information processing. Yet excitatory and inhibitory populations can differ in their modular organization, and it remains unclear how this asymmetry affects network dynamics and computation. Here, using dynamical mean-field theory and simulations of networks performing complex temporal tasks, we show that independently tuning excitatory and inhibitory modularity controls the dynamical regimes of balanced E/I networks. In particular, such tuning can generate a dominant spectral outlier despite overall E/I balance, producing a topology-controlled transition between bulk- and low-rank-dominated regimes, with different dynamical bifurcations leading to chaos and bistability, respectively. In chaotic time-series prediction tasks, computational performance is enhanced near these dynamical boundaries, including both the onset of chaos and the transition to bistability. Favorable configurations exhibit strongly modular excitation and comparatively homogeneous inhibition, similar to what is observed in cortical connectivity.
summary:
1. 作者结合动态平均场理论与回声状态网络仿真，研究平衡速率网络中独立调节兴奋、抑制模块化如何改变动力学与时序预测。
2. 整体平衡下，拓扑不对称仍可产生主导谱离群值，使谱体与低秩主导的失稳分别通向混沌和双稳态，所测四类混沌序列的预测在强模块化兴奋、较均匀抑制的双稳态边界附近最优。
3. 这为储备池拓扑设计提供依据，但有限尺寸与外部驱动会使性能边界偏离无输入理论，生物适用性仍待验证。

title: Hidden entropic order of emergent charges in a classical Ampère spin liquid
abstract: Classical spin liquids are characterized by an extensive number of ground-state configurations. Coulomb spin liquids have, in this ground-state manifold, a divergence-free local constraint, which gives dipolar correlations and pinch points in the structure factor. Recently, models with a complementary ground-state constraint, defined by a zero-circulation constraint (Ampère's law), have been proposed. While classical Coulomb spin liquids forbid emergent charges, their Ampère counterparts leave the charges unconstrained. Here we study an Ising Ampère model on the octochlore lattice. The ground states obey a Gauss law for an antisymmetric rank-two field, i.e., three coupled two-dimensional Gauss laws, which are expected to produce pinch points in the structure factor. Nevertheless, maximal charges, vertices with all six arrows in or out, spontaneously accumulate on one of the two sublattices of the cubic lattice, with disordered signs. This order has a purely entropic origin; it washes out the pinch-point singularities at large scales, produces no magnetic Bragg peaks, and coexists with an extensive entropy. The system enters into this sublattice long-range ordered state through a continuous transition in what seems to be the three-dimensional Ising universality class. Moreover, the state has no magnetic order; it is even under time reversal: it is a hidden, entropic order within the Ampère manifold. Thus, a system whose Gauss law would predict an algebraic spin liquid becomes, through a non-magnetic ordering transition, a partially ordered short-range spin liquid. Our study is based on a combination of the constraint-vector theory, exact bounds and enumeration, and Monte Carlo, Wang-Landau, and parallel-tempering simulations.
summary:
1. 针对零旋度约束下涌现电荷是否有序，作者结合约束理论、精确计数与多种蒙特卡洛模拟，研究顶点共享八面体晶格上的伊辛安培模型。
2. 纯熵驱动的最大电荷子晶格序抹平夹点奇异性，而电荷符号无长程序、不产生磁布拉格峰，每自旋剩余熵仍达0.1223(1)k_B。
3. 结果表明高斯定律并不自动保证代数自旋关联，而连续转变虽接近三维伊辛类，其普适性归属仍需更大尺寸检验。

title: Thermally Conditioned Time-Series Forecasting of Grain Growth in Polycrystalline Materials
abstract: Grain growth during heat treatment strongly affects the microstructure of polycrystalline materials and, consequently, their mechanical properties. Although numerical methods such as front-tracking or front-capturing simulations can accurately describe grain growth, their high computational cost limits their use for long or non-isothermal thermal cycles. In previous work, grain growth was successfully predicted under isothermal conditions by treating grain size distributions as time series and forecasting their evolution using recurrent neural networks, allowing complete grain growth trajectories to be generated in seconds rather than through costly PDE-based simulations. In the present work, this forecasting framework is reformulated to handle non-isothermal conditions by explicitly incorporating thermal information into the model architecture. Grain size distributions are encoded using a convolutional neural network, thermal descriptors are embedded through a dedicated multilayer perceptron, and temporal evolution is predicted using a recurrent network. Instantaneous temperature and thermal rate are provided at each time step, allowing the model to adapt its predictions to changing thermal conditions. The framework is trained and evaluated on datasets generated from validated front-tracking simulations across a wide range of non-isothermal thermal paths. The results show that the thermally conditioned model accurately reproduces grain growth dynamics under complex thermal histories, achieving, in k-fold cross-validation over all simulations, mean relative errors of 2.99% (one-hour cycles) and 4.51% (four-hour cycles) with coefficients of determination exceeding 0.99, and mean relative errors between 1.91% and 14.66% on ten simulations following four unseen thermal histories of increasing complexity.
summary:
1. 针对热历程对晶粒长大的影响，作者用二维前沿追踪模拟训练CNN–MLP–LSTM网络，将晶粒尺寸分布与温度、温变率联合用于非等温演化预测。
2. 热条件输入使一小时周期的交叉验证平均相对误差由45.26%降至2.99%，四小时周期为4.51%，说明显式热信息是超越单纯尺寸历史预测的关键。
3. 该方法有望辅助热处理设计，但需预知热历程，验证限于二维各向同性晶界模拟，未见热历程下的平均相对误差最高达14.66%。

title: Exact thermal correlators at vanishing momenta and the black hole singularity
abstract: We study thermal two- and three-point functions of scalar primaries in holographic CFTs dual to AdS black branes. The three-point function arises from a cubic scalar interaction in the bulk. At vanishing external momenta, the tree-level results can be written in closed form and are exact in the operator dimensions. We reproduce them through direct CFT calculations in two dimensions. Their large-dimension expansions contain subleading exponential terms encoding the radial proper time from the horizon to the black hole singularity. These results provide an exact test of earlier WKB and saddle-point predictions for higher-point thermal correlators, confirming the proper-time signature while correcting the predicted asymptotic form.
summary:
1. 为检验热关联如何编码黑洞奇点，作者利用AdS黑膜的精确传播子，求得零外动量标量二点及接触三点函数对算符维数精确的闭式解，并以二维共形场论独立核验。
2. 维数解析延拓后的大维数展开表明，领头指数取决于边界至视界距离，视界至奇点的固有时τ_s=πR/d进入次领指数项，修正了既有WKB预测。
3. 这一零动量树级基准可约束半经典近似，精确WKB分析有望厘清尚未解决的视界端点与复鞍点贡献。

title: Satisfying Freed--Witten quantization on smooth divisors in Calabi--Yau orientifolds
abstract: Freed--Witten quantization conditions on several divisors wrapped by D-branes must be satisfied with one bulk $B$-field. On a smooth Calabi--Yau threefold $X$ with a holomorphic O3/O7 involution $\sigma$, we show that the common background $B_{2,+}^{\star}=\tfrac12[R]$, where $R$ is the total O7 divisor, permits Freed--Witten period quantization on the full two-cycle lattice of \emph{every smooth connected divisor}, modulo torsion. The worldvolume fluxes are chosen individually and obey the orientifold relation between each divisor and its image. The central step concerns setwise invariant divisors $D$: we prove that the bulk Freed--Witten class $\eta_D^\star=\tfrac12([R]+[D])|_D$ has integer periods on every $\sigma$-even integral two-cycle class, including inherited and autochthonous classes. Its periods on purely $\sigma$-odd classes vanish, so any remaining non-integer periods occur only on classes that are neither $\sigma$-even nor $\sigma$-odd. We show how to choose $\sigma$-odd worldvolume fluxes on these invariant divisors that make all periods integral. For exchanged divisor pairs, quantizing the flux on one member automatically quantizes its orientifold image. On invariant divisors with $h^{2,0}_-(D)=0$, the constructed flux is of type $(1,1)$ and admits a primitive representative; this includes every smooth rigid invariant divisor. We also study zero worldvolume flux on invariant divisors. For $h^{1,1}_-(X)\leq1$, we construct common bulk backgrounds satisfying every inherited intersection period on all such divisors. A binary compatibility test determines whether a common shift exists for larger $h^{1,1}_-(X)$. Non-inherited period tests then determine whether the resulting backgrounds allow zero flux on the full worldvolume lattices.
summary:
1. 针对多D膜共享B场的Freed–Witten周期量子化问题，作者在光滑Calabi–Yau三维O3/O7定向折叠中，结合Wu公式、固定集交数恒等式与奇通量格构造给出证明。
2. 共同背景B₂,₊=[R]/2（R为总O7除子）配合逐除子选择的兼容通量，可在忽略挠元时量子化所有光滑连通除子的完整二循环格，包括非继承类。
3. 这为多瞬子构造提供量子化起点，但零通量还需检验非继承周期，瞬子能否贡献超势仍须另验超对称性、投影与零模。

title: Goldstone theory of gluon saturation in high energy QCD: From color glass to color superfluid condensate
abstract: In the high energy Regge asymptotics of QCD, the rapid overpopulation of gluons leads to gluon saturation, characterized by nonperturbative semi-classical lumpy configurations of size $1/Q_S$, where $Q_S\gg \Lambda_{\rm QCD}$ is a dynamical semi-hard saturation scale. We discuss here a generalization of the Color Glass Condensate (CGC) framework describing this phenomenon that is obtained by carefully treating the breaking of global symmetries by the condensate. In particular, we show that the breaking of a global subgroup of color results in a Goldstone effective field theory (EFT) whose dynamics is characterized by a Goldstone decay constant $f_G = \sqrt{N} Q_S$, where $N=O(1/\alpha_S)$ is the phase space occupancy of the condensate, which is large for $\alpha_S(Q_S)\ll 1$. Further, the coupling of these colored Goldstones to collinear gluon modes leads to a depletion of the condensate, thereby modifying the static shockwave scattering framework of the CGC on timescales controlled by $f_G$. The CGC EFT on these longer time scales is a novel color superfluid. Low frequency modes with $\omega\leq \alpha_S Q_S$ in an external probe of the CGC are sensitive to superfluid dynamics, with interesting physical consequences for deeply inelastic scattering and ultrarelativistic nuclear collisions.
summary:
1. 针对饱和胶子凝聚体何时不再静态的问题，作者保持局域规范不变性，结合全局色对称性的近似破缺与余伴随轨道作用量，扩展色玻璃凝聚体有效理论。
2. 所得理论具有色超流结构，允许戈德斯通模耦合共线胶子而耗减凝聚体，并参量估计戈德斯通尺度$f_G\sim Q_S/\sqrt{\alpha_S}$及动力学启动时间$\tau_G\sim(\alpha_SQ_S)^{-1}$。
3. 深度非弹性散射中的低频模可能探测静态冲击波近似之外的动力学，但具体可观测信号与有效参数仍待定量计算和实验约束。

title: Schwinger Effect with a Transversal Boundary
abstract: We study the effect of a boundary on pair production by an electric field. In particular, we are interested in the case in which the electric field has a normal component with respect to the boundary. This is essentially more complex than pure tangential fields due to the reflection of created particles against the boundary. In this article we provide the explicit solution for the case of an instantaneous electric pulse which is spatially uniform and normal to a flat surface. We show that pair production exhibits a bulk contribution that accounts for the interference of reflected modes, in addition to a purely boundary term. To conclude, we give an expression for the total particle production due to an irrotational electric pulse in a region delimited by an arbitrary boundary.
summary:
1. 为厘清法向电场下边界反射对粒子对产生的影响，作者用博戈柳博夫变换显式求解狄利克雷边界半直线上的标量场瞬时均匀电脉冲模型。
2. 体项等于无边界谱的正负动量对称化，边界修正主要为负，而长区间的数值结果支持边界项相对半直线加倍。
3. 推广所得谱公式可处理任意有界区域的无旋瞬时脉冲，但已解一维模型的能量转移发散，有限脉宽效应仍待研究。

title: Complex phase diagram and thermodynamic supercriticality of five-dimensional four-charge AdS black holes in $STU-W^2U$ gauged supergravity
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the complex phase structure and thermodynamic supercriticality of static four-charge anti-de Sitter (AdS) black holes in five-dimensional $STU-W^2U$ gauged supergravity, with all four physical electric charges held fixed. A Van der Waals-like first-order small/large black hole phase transition is found to terminate at a critical point. By analytically continuing the fixed-charge thermodynamic relations, we trace the two real spinodal singularities through criticality into a complex-conjugate pair in the supercritical region. The corresponding spinodal temperatures exhibit the characteristic $3/2$ near-critical scaling, connecting the subcritical temperature splitting with the imaginary parts of the supercritical complex temperatures. We construct the associated complex phase diagram and identify a Widom-type crossover line from the real-temperature projection of the complex spinodals. This line progressively deviates from the locus of real heat-capacity maxima as the pressure increases. At higher pressures, the real heat-capacity extrema eventually merge and disappear, while the complex spinodal singularities persist. Together, these results reveal a continuous connection between critical phase transitions and supercritical thermodynamics through complex singularity structures, providing further insight into the thermodynamic phase behavior of multicharge supergravity black holes.
summary:
1. 针对黑洞临界性如何延续至超临界区，作者在五维STU-W²U规范超引力中固定四个物理电荷，解析延拓视界约束与热力学关系。
2. 所选构型的实旋节奇点越过临界点后成为复共轭对，临界两侧温度分裂与虚部均呈3/2标度，实热容极值在P/P_c≈1.228合并消失后复奇点仍可追踪。
3. 复奇点的实温投影提供区别于热容峰线的Widom型交叉刻画，而非新相界，其对电荷配置和解分支的依赖仍待研究。

title: Chiral edge modes from lattice Chern-Simons theory
abstract: It is shown that a level $k$ Abelian lattice Chern-Simons theory with continuum time and a spatial square lattice, which is a topological field theory on the latticized plane and torus, when quantized on a spatial cylinder reduces to chiral edge excitations, exactly localized on the two boundaries and carrying two commuting lattice versions of the level-$k$ $U(1)$ Kac-Moody algebra of opposite chirality. The algebras are represented on a Fock space in the noncompact theory and by a finite Weyl algebra in the compact one. We also observe that the theory has a natural framing of Wilson loops which exhibits the correct framing anomaly.
summary:
1. 为检验纯拓扑晶格理论能否支持手性边缘态，作者在连续时间、空间方格晶格的圆柱上，对U(1)陈–西蒙斯理论作辛约化与量子化。
2. 无需麦克斯韦项即得到精确局域于两边界、手性相反的边缘模；非紧致情形承载k级电流代数，紧致情形则由有限外尔代数描述，前者加入局域边界能量后具有无反向分支的色散ω=2v tan(p/2)。
3. 结果展示了规避晶格倍增限制的机制：非局域性来自体约束诱导的边界对易关系，而传播动力学仍须另加边界哈密顿量。

title: Static and dynamical Casimir effects in a wedge within the worldline formulation
abstract: We study a real massless scalar field in $d+1$ dimensions confined to a wedge of opening angle $\alpha$, in the presence of a semitransparent circular arc that may oscillate radially. Within the worldline formulation, and for an arbitrary strength $\lambda$ of the $\delta$-potential that models the arc, we expand the effective action in powers of the radial displacement $R$ of the arc. In this formulation, all the information about the media is contained in the propagator of a non-relativistic point particle, so that known results for that propagator can be used directly. At zeroth order we obtain the Casimir energy of the wedge, with Dirichlet, Neumann or mixed walls, and the contribution of the arc in closed form for arbitrary $\lambda$. We show that the worldline integrand is, point by point, the energy density obtained from the energy-momentum tensor of the scalar field with curvature coupling $\xi=1/4$; with this identification, and using dimensional regularization for the integrated quantities, we recover the known results for the wedge and for the wedge closed by a Dirichlet arc. At second order in $R$, we reduce the form factor that determines the imaginary part of the in-out effective action, and hence the probability of pair creation by the moving arc, to a one-loop expression involving the radial Green's functions of each angular sector. In the narrow-wedge limit, each angular sector behaves as a field with a mass set by the angular quantization, coupled to a moving $\delta$-mirror; for a Dirichlet arc, the pair creation spectrum of the exterior region approaches that of a planar massive mirror, while the interior region behaves as a tapered cavity. Finally, by decomposing the electromagnetic field into TE and TM scalars, we obtain the Casimir energy of wedges with perfectly conducting, perfectly permeable and mixed walls.
summary:
1. 作者用世界线方法研究楔形内无质量标量场的真空能与粒子对产生，将半透明圆弧的径向运动纳入有效作用量的位移二阶展开。
2. 得到任意非负耦合强度下的静态能量公式，证明被积函数对应曲率耦合ξ=1/4时的局域能量密度，并将耗散核化为径向格林函数的一圈表达式。
3. 窄楔中狄利克雷圆弧的外侧辐射趋近有质量场的平面镜谱、内侧仍为渐缩腔，而运动导体的电磁推广尚须纳入TE–TM混合。

title: Partially Massless Condensates and Reentrant NUT/Bolt Phase Transitions in Conformal Gravity
abstract: We study non-Einstein Bach-flat Taub-NUT/Bolt instantons with weakened AdS boundary conditions. In particular, the next-to-leading-order coefficient in the Fefferman--Graham expansion is nonvanishing, and it sources the partially massless response in the dual conformal field theory. As in the Einstein case, the holographic stress tensor of these instantons represents a perfect fluid with vorticity. Remarkably, we identify a non-Einstein Taub-Bolt branch supporting a nonvanishing partially massless response at zero source, while preserving the full symmetry of the squashed conformal boundary. The additional holographic degrees of freedom enrich the thermodynamic phase structure, allowing the conventional NUT/Bolt transition to disappear or give way to reentrant transitions. We further show that non-Einstein Bolts can possess negative thermodynamic volume and establish the absence of negative modes of a conformally coupled probe scalar on regular Bach-flat NUT backgrounds.
summary:
1. 为厘清额外引力模如何改变全息响应与相竞争，作者对四维共形引力中放宽AdS边界条件的Taub-NUT/Bolt瞬子作渐近展开，并在相同边界源下比较欧氏作用量。
2. 非爱因斯坦Bolt分支支持保持边界全部对称性的零源部分无质量响应，而额外源可使相变消失或出现Bolt–NUT–Bolt一阶重入序列。
3. 将这些相变解释为对偶有涡流体的平衡态转换仍需引力扰动与输运分析，目前无负模证明仅适用于标准量子化下NUT背景的共形耦合探针标量。

title: Gluon and Faddeev--Popov ghost propagators in rotating background: An eigenfunction approach
abstract: We construct the free gluon and Faddeev--Popov ghost propagators in rigidly rotating cylindrical coordinates using an eigenfunction approach within the Feynman gauge. Starting from the quadratic gauge-fixed QCD action, we derive the corresponding kinetic operators and obtain their spectral representations. For the gluon field, a circular polarization basis diagonalizes the vector wave operator, leading to polarization-dependent shifts in the orders of the radial Bessel functions. In the absence of radial boundaries, we explicitly recover the standard Minkowski propagator in inertial Cartesian coordinates, showing that the off-diagonal tensor components in the cylindrical basis have a geometrical origin. We then extend the construction to a finite-radius cylinder satisfying the causality condition $|\Omega|R<1$, imposing relative boundary conditions on the gluon field and Dirichlet conditions on the ghosts. The resulting discrete transverse spectra involve both Dirichlet and Neumann eigenvalues for the gluon modes, from which we obtain explicit spectral representations of the propagators. Our results provide a consistent framework for perturbative QCD calculations in rotating geometries, retaining the angular-momentum, polarization, and boundary effects relevant to future studies of correlation functions and radiative corrections.
summary:
1. 针对旋转与边界如何进入规范场传播的问题，作者在费曼规范下，以圆偏振基和本征函数展开构造刚性旋转圆柱中的自由胶子及鬼场传播子。
2. 无边界时传播子还原为闵可夫斯基形式，非对角项源于基底几何；有限圆柱的相对边界条件使胶子横向谱分为狄利克雷与诺伊曼两支，鬼场则采用狄利克雷谱。
3. 结果为后续圈修正提供基础，但本文限于自由场，且因果性要求|Ω|R<1，不能在固定非零角速度下取无限半径极限。

title: On phases of 4d $Spin/SO$ Yang-Mills theories
abstract: We study the low-temperature phase diagrams of $Spin(N)/SO(N)_\pm$ Yang-Mills theories as functions of the $\theta$-parameter. In particular, for every even integer $N\geq 4$, we find a phase diagram consistent with the center/CP mixed anomaly, via the technique of mixed gauge theory. The resulting phase diagrams are in perfect agreement with the phase diagrams of $Spin(N)/SO(N)_\pm$ super Yang-Mills theory softly broken by a small gaugino mass. In the case of $Spin(4k)$ Yang-Mills for an integer $k\geq 2$, only two phases appear in the phase diagram, while in the $Spin(4)$ case the phase diagram contains four SPT phases protected by the $\mathbb{Z}_2\times \mathbb{Z}_2$ center symmetry. In the case of $Spin(4k+2)$ Yang-Mills for a positive integer $k$, the phase diagram contains four SPT phases protected by the $\mathbb{Z}_4$ center symmetry.
summary:
1. 作者将四维Spin(N)/SO(N)±杨–米尔斯理论圆紧致化并规范化三维一形式对称性，利用中心–CP混合反常构造偶数N≥4的低温θ候选相图。
2. Spin(4k)（k≥2）、Spin(4)和Spin(4k+2)（k≥1）分别呈现两、四、四种中心对称性保护的拓扑相（含平庸相），所得相图与小规范微子质量下的软破缺超对称结果一致。
3. 这一吻合提示相图可能不随规范微子质量改变，但候选结构依赖全θ有隙及θ=0真空唯一且平庸的假设，仍需数值检验。

title: Spectral flow in AdS$\mathbf{_3}$ revisited
abstract: We revisit an old idea that spectral flow in WZW models can be associated with certain $G$-bundles over a worldsheet. This allows us to introduce a novel method for computing correlators of spectrally-flowed vertex operators in WZW models with group $G$ and level $k$, by systematically computing the contribution from a network of line defects. Specialising to the case of $G=SL(2, \mathbb{R})$, as is relevant to AdS$_3$ string theory, we demonstrate that generic $n$-point functions of spectrally-flowed vertex operators at tree level can be rewritten in terms of an $(n+1)$-point function of $n$ unflowed vertex operators and one degenerate insertion. This is to be interpreted as an unflowed $n$-point function in an instanton background. Moreover, we conjecture that this $(n+1)$-point function can be recast as an $n$-point function of unflowed operators and we provide evidence for this. We demonstrate that the $(n+1)$-point function satisfies the same constraints from global spacetime conformal invariance as does an unflowed $n$-point function for a specific choice of spacetime coordinates that we determine. We verify that our results agree with bootstrap results in the literature. This provides the next step towards fully solving the $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ WZW model.
summary:
1. 为简化AdS₃弦论的谱流关联函数计算，作者在SL(2,ℝ) WZW模型中用世界面非平凡丛解释谱流，并通过线缺陷网络变形重组关联函数。
2. 证明球面谱流n点函数可化为已知前因子乘以含n个无谱流算符及一个退化插入的关联函数，并复现两点结果、确认总谱流W≤12的531例四点交比与自举结果一致。
3. 这一瞬子背景表述为求解模型提供路径，但进一步化为无背景的无谱流n点函数仍属猜想，一般情形的世界面共形与KZ约束尚待验证。

title: A dynamical Einstein-Proca-dilaton holographic model and exotic hybrid meson resonances
abstract: A fully dynamical Einstein-Proca-dilaton (EPD) holographic model is developed for the exotic $J^{PC}=1^{-+}$ hybrid meson, incorporating the backreaction of the massive vector field dual to the hybrid current in the bulk. Solving the coupled EPD system yields a self-consistent gravitational background and the mass spectrum of hybrid resonances. While the soft-wall limit reproduces linear Regge behavior, the inclusion of backreaction yields quantitative shifts that improve agreement with experimental candidates. The finite-temperature regime is approached by studying black hole thermodynamics and spectral functions across the confinement-deconfinement transition, fixing the Hawking-Page temperature to $T_c \sim 150 \, \mathrm{MeV}$. Unlike non-backreacted AdS/QCD models, the dynamical background predicts a strong suppression of hybrid states already near the onset of deconfinement. These results demonstrate that gravitational backreaction has measurable consequences for both vacuum spectroscopy and in-medium properties of exotic hybrid mesons, emphasizing the relevance of a dynamical self-consistent approach in AdS/QCD.
summary:
1. 为研究动力学背景对1⁻⁺杂化介子质量与热稳定性的影响，作者以势重构建立五维爱因斯坦–普罗卡–膨胀子模型，计算质量谱和零动量谱函数。
2. 所选参数下，自洽背景将基态质量从软墙值1555.6降至1396.5 MeV，更接近实验候选态，且热谱在校准的约150 MeV解禁闭温度附近已显著展宽。
3. 热谱计算仅覆盖解禁闭黑洞支，尚不能定位熔解起点，而有限密度推广需另加麦克斯韦场，不能将普罗卡源视为化学势。

title: Striped phases of N=4 SYM at finite density
abstract: We construct spatially modulated phases of strongly coupled $\mathcal N=4$ supersymmetric Yang--Mills theory at finite $R$-charge density. Compactification on a three-torus and unequal background charges isolate an unstable charge-density mode. Its static threshold seeds a nonlinear branch of striped black branes in the STU model. The striped states have higher entropy than homogeneous states with the same energy and conserved charges. They connect continuously to the homogeneous branch, with an entropy excess that begins at fourth order in the modulation amplitude. These solutions provide a candidate endpoint of the charge-transport instability.
summary:
1. 针对有限R电荷密度强耦合N=4超对称杨–米尔斯理论的输运失稳，作者在三环面上用非等背景电荷隔离不稳定模，并在STU全息模型中从静态阈值数值构造非线性条纹黑膜。
2. 所得分支连续连接均匀态，在匹配能量、全部三项电荷和环面周期时具有更高熵，近阈值熵增始于调制振幅四阶。
3. 这些解提供候选终态，但完整动力学稳定性尚未检验，且近阈值条纹在多周期域仍有长周期失稳，真正终态仍待确定。

title: Quasi-Normal Modes and thermalization in integrable Quantum Field Theories from the Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz
abstract: We propose a Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz (TBA) approach for describing thermalization in integrable quantum field theories. The exponential damping and oscillations when approaching thermal equilibrium can be understood as the analogs of quasi-normal mode (QNM) frequencies of black hole perturbations within the framework of holography. Holographic intuitions and some general properties of thermal Green's functions motivate the existence of such a TBA formulation, as well as lead to the imposition of a nonstandard analytical structure on the QNM TBA, while comparison with integrable form-factor expansions fixes the remaining ingredients. We conjecture the QNM TBA to be equivalent to performing an all-order resummation of secular terms in a thermal form factor expansion of retarded 2-point correlation functions. We compare the predictions with tensor network simulations of the E8 deformation of Ising CFT at nonzero temperature. We conjecture that the QNM TBA framework should also be applicable for describing out-of-equilibrium approach to Generalized Hydrodynamics (GHD).
summary:
1. 针对可积量子场论零动量扰动的热弛豫，作者结合散射数据与形状因子展开，提出具有非标准解析结构的准正规模热力学贝特拟设。
2. 该方程复现伊辛模型已知的精确衰减率，其复频率预测在m/T=2.352时经振幅拟合与E8模型的张量网络响应相符。
3. 相互作用情形的全阶重求和等价性仍属猜想，完整模谱及向广义流体力学背景弛豫的推广尚待验证。

title: Higher Integrability, Generalized Symmetries, and Partially Topological Field Theories
abstract: We exhibit a classical link between higher Lax integrability and generalized symmetries in a non-Lorentzian higher semi-holomorphic Chern--Simons theory on $M\times\mathbb CP^1$. The equations of motion determine a spectrally dependent flat higher connection on $M$ whose Laurent coefficients organise an infinite hierarchy of conserved quantities. We construct a spectral family of classical $(d_M-2)$-form symmetry line defects associated with the Lax connection, establish an action-preserving deformation law, and exhibit suitable gauge-invariant probes on which the induced transformations act nontrivially.
summary:
1. 为厘清高阶可积性与广义对称性的联系，作者利用非洛伦兹不变高阶半全纯Chern–Simons理论的BF型结构，构造谱依赖的经典对称线缺陷。
2. 在壳平坦的高阶Lax联络组织无穷守恒荷层级，缺陷移动与体场变换联合离壳保持作用量，并对受限场构型上的规范不变探针产生非零作用。
3. 这一经典实现为部分拓扑理论中的高形式对称性研究提供范例，但量子缺陷能否存在仍需反常检验，不能仅由经典平坦性推出。

title: Form Factors in AdS from the Worldsheet
abstract: We study AdS form factors describing closed strings scattering off D-branes. Assuming that these form factors admit worldsheet integral representations in terms of multiple polylogarithms, we determine their leading curvature corrections around the flat-space limit by matching their pole structure to CFT data. We focus on two examples of defects in 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM: a $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS 't Hooft loop, dual to a D1 brane, and a pair of giant gravitons, dual to a D3 brane. For the 't Hooft loop, the worldsheet bootstrap completely fixes the form factor, and the result passes nontrivial checks from supersymmetric localization. For the giant gravitons, the bootstrap initially leaves five free coefficients, one of which can be fixed using localization. Remarkably, imposing instead that no new operators appear in the defect channel at this order fixes all five coefficients and reproduces the localization constraint. Under this additional assumption, we therefore obtain a unique D3-brane form factor, with supersymmetric localization providing an independent check.
summary:
1. 针对AdS中闭弦与D1、D3膜散射，作者以多重多对数世界面积分为拟设，匹配缺陷共形场论两通道的极点与留数，重建首阶曲率修正。
2. D1修正在所选单值多对数对角基底内唯一并通过局域化检验，结果保留完整弦尺度动量依赖，还给出雷吉轨道的加权谱与OPE修正。
3. D3的五个未定系数可由该阶缺陷通道无新算符的附加假设固定，并独立吻合局域化约束，但该解仍属猜想，高阶推广需更多共形场论数据。

title: 5-brane webs and generalised symmetries
abstract: 5-brane webs provide a powerful geometric description of five-dimensional quantum field theories, encoding data such as symmetries and dualities. Although the extraction of continuous 0-form symmetries from these systems is well understood, their higher-form symmetries have received less attention. We develop a microscopic prescription for determining 1-form symmetries directly from 5-brane webs. BPS Wilson lines are represented by configurations of D3-branes and $(p,q)$ strings, while their screening by local operators is realised through string junctions, Higgsing, and Hanany-Witten transitions. For webs without orientifold planes, this construction reproduces the Smith normal form prescription based on asymptotic 7-brane charges. We extend the analysis to webs containing O7- and O5- planes. For O7$^-$-planes, the resolved 7-brane charges can be incorporated into the Smith normal form, whereas for O7$^+$-planes we propose an effective charge prescription and test it in both Lagrangian and non-Lagrangian examples. For webs with O5-planes, configurations of half-D3-branes reproduce the centre symmetries of Spin gauge theories and their breaking by matter. Crucially, we find that the 1-form symmetry of an O5-plane system is not determined by asymptotic data alone, but can depend on the local structure of the brane configuration near the orientifold.
summary:
1. 为从五维超对称理论的五膜网确定一形式对称性，作者用D3膜和弦构造Wilson线，并通过弦接合、横向移除及Hanany–Witten跃迁刻画屏蔽。
2. 该构造重现普通膜网的Smith标准形结果及Spin理论的中心对称性，并表明O5系统的一形式对称性还依赖平面附近的局域结构，不能仅由渐近电荷确定。
3. 该方法可用于非拉格朗日理论，但O7⁺的[2,0]有效电荷及O5⁻上的D弦奇偶规则虽经实例检验，仍待基本原理推导。

title: Exact Splitting of Amplitudes and One-Loop Integrands: A Classical Origin of Zeros
abstract: We introduce a recursion based on hidden zeros that reconstructs complete tree level scattering amplitudes and one-loop integrands at generic kinematics. The recursion takes a universal exact-splitting form: both tree amplitudes and one-loop surface integrands are expressed as sums of products of complete tree functions, with the chosen zero conditions manifest in every term. We establish this structure for cubic scalar theory, the nonlinear sigma model, and inverse string Kawai--Lewellen--Tye (KLT) functions. We derive the tree splitting formula from the equations of motion, showing that hidden zeros arise when the product of two currents solves the equations of motion, while corrections away from the zero reconstruct the full amplitude. We further show that inverse KLT is the unique extension of $\mathrm{Tr}(\phi^3)$ with higher-point non-derivative interactions that preserves hidden zeros.
summary:
1. 为揭示隐零点如何组织完整散射，作者通过经典运动方程与径向留数，在三次标量理论、非线性σ模型及逆弦KLT函数中建立精确分裂递推。
2. 在一般运动学和任意外腿数下，树振幅与单圈曲面被积函数均写成完整树函数乘积之和，在所选零点上逐项消失，而树级零点源于两个流的乘积满足经典运动方程。
3. 该递推有望揭示新的单圈零点，但圈动量积分后结构是否保留，以及能否推广至杨–米尔斯理论，仍属开放问题。

title: Anomaly effective actions for 4d $\mathcal{N}=1$ superconformal field theories
abstract: We present a comprehensive analysis of the Wess-Zumino anomaly effective action of four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ superconformal field theories in components. After reviewing the coset construction of the Wess-Zumino action in the presence of an unbroken subgroup, the gauging of the conformal algebra and the Wess-Zumino effective action for non-supersymmetric conformal field theories with a U(1) symmetry in two and four dimensions, we revisit the superconformal anomalies of $\mathcal{N}=1$ conformal supergravity. Solving the Wess-Zumino consistency conditions we determine both the bosonic and fermionic superconformal anomalies in a two-parameter family of schemes, to quadratic order in the gravitino. Turning on a chiral compensator multiplet and identifying a local super-Poincaré subalgebra of the conformal supergravity algebra without gauge-fixing the coset symmetries, we employ the coset construction and the superconformal anomalies in order to evaluate the Wess-Zumino action for generic $\mathcal{N}=1$ superconformal field theories coupled to conformal supergravity. By construction, this action reproduces the Weyl, R-symmetry, and S-supersymmetry coset anomalies, but its transformation under the unbroken Poincaré supersymmetry differs from the corresponding anomaly of the conformal supergravity functional. We show that there exists a local functional of the coset-invariant old-minimal fields that, when added to the Wess-Zumino action, results in a generalized Wess-Zumino action that reproduces all anomalies of the conformal supergravity functional. The same local functional enables us to determine the super-Weyl anomalies and the Wess-Zumino action of old-minimal supergravity, providing a component version of the known superspace Wess-Zumino action.
summary:
1. 为刻画四维N=1超共形场论的反常，作者引入手征补偿多重态，用陪集法构造耦合共形超引力的Wess–Zumino作用量。
2. 通过一致性条件确定双参数方案族中的玻色与费米反常，并加入局域泛函修正未破缺庞加莱超对称的反常失配，使广义作用量再现全部反常。
3. 同一泛函还给出旧极小超引力的超Weyl反常及已知超空间作用量的分量形式，建立两种表述的对应，但费米结果限于引力微子二阶。

title: Conformal field theory from automorphic forms on a quantum group
abstract: We reformulate two-dimensional conformal field theory (2d CFT) in the language of noncommutative geometry. To this end, we introduce automorphic forms for the von Neumann algebraic quantum group $\mathrm{SL}^+_b(2,\mathbb{R})$. A quantum measure space is a von Neumann algebra equipped with a weight. We study such spaces carrying a weight-preserving action of $\mathrm{SL}^+_b(2,\mathbb{R})$. We argue that every unitary bosonic 2d CFT with central charge $c=1+6(b+b^{-1})^2>1$ is equivalent to a quantum measure space with an action of $\mathrm{SL}^+_b(2,\mathbb{R})\times\mathrm{SL}^+_b(2,\mathbb{R})$. In this dictionary, Virasoro primary operators are quantum automorphic forms and their scaling dimensions correspond to the spectrum of a quantum Laplace operator. The Virasoro crossing equations express associativity of multiplication on the quantum measure space. For compact theories, the algebra is a type III$_1$ factor. Liouville CFT is realized as $\mathrm{SL}^+_b(2,\mathbb{R})$ acting on itself by left and right translations. Virasoro boundary conditions correspond to quantum measure spaces with an action of a single copy of $\mathrm{SL}^+_b(2,\mathbb{R})$. When the boundary spectrum is discrete, these are noncommutative counterparts of compact hyperbolic surfaces. The formulation accommodates models both with and without extended chiral algebras. It bridges the Virasoro conformal bootstrap with categorical and von Neumann algebraic approaches to 2d CFT.
summary:
1. 作者引入量子群SL⁺_b(2,ℝ)上的自守形式，提出中心荷c=1+6(b+b⁻¹)²>1的幺正玻色二维共形场论与具有两份该量子群保权作用的量子测度空间等价。
2. 其字典将初级算符和标度维数分别对应于量子自守形式和拉普拉斯谱，将交叉方程解释为乘法结合律，并以量子群的左右平移实现Liouville理论。
3. 这一表述为衔接Virasoro自举与算子代数方法提供框架，而离散边界谱对应的量子测度空间可视为紧双曲曲面的非交换对应物。

title: Representation theory and massive spectral zeta functions on spherical space forms
abstract: We study the spectral theory of the massive scalar kinetic operator on spherical space forms $\Gamma \backslash S^{3}$, where $\Gamma$ is a finite subgroup of $\mathrm{SO}(4)$ acting freely on $S^{3}$. Using the Peter-Weyl theorem and Molien series we compute the spectrum of the Laplace-Beltrami operator on $\Gamma\backslash S^3$ directly from representation theory, obtaining the eigenvalues and their multiplicities for all lens spaces $L(p,q)$ and for each ADE-class of finite subgroups of $\mathrm{SU}(2)$, which includes homogeneous lens spaces, prism spaces and quotients by the binary tetrahedral, octahedral and icosahedral groups, the last also known as the Poincaré homology sphere. For homogeneous quotients by subgroups of even order, we construct the meromorphic continuation of the spectral zeta function of the massive kinetic operator and obtain the general zeta-regularized determinant in closed form. The determinant is expressed as a finite sum of polylogarithms, valid for all real mass, and depends on $\Gamma$ only through its order and a finite set of parameters which we call twist coefficients fixed by the dimensions of the $\Gamma$-invariant subspaces. As a complementary approach, we express the heat trace of the kinetic operator on spherical space forms in terms of Jacobi theta functions, whose modular properties relate the spectral zeta function to geometric data, the volume and closed geodesic lengths of $\Gamma\backslash S^3$. We find that the spectral zeta function admits a rapidly convergent expansion in the heavy mass sector in terms of modified Bessel functions, and provides an independent check on the determinant. This framework extends to quotients of higher-dimensional manifolds directly, which we outline for future work.
summary:
1. 为计算球形商空间上标量场的单圈修正，作者用Peter–Weyl定理和Molien级数求得全部三维透镜空间及ADE类商空间的谱与简并度。
2. 对SU(2)偶数阶子群生成的齐性商空间，获得ζ正则化行列式对数的多对数函数有限和闭式，覆盖全部实质量，并在无质量情形剔除零模。
3. 热迹模变换将谱与体积、闭测地线联系，重质量区的贝塞尔展开独立核验行列式，而高维商空间的有质量行列式及非紧背景推广仍待完成。

title: Rough-to-frozen transition in non-integrable dimer models
abstract: The transition from rough to frozen phases in models of random surfaces is expected to be governed by the Pokrovsky-Talapov law, which predicts a $\varepsilon^{3/2}$-type singularity of the macroscopic height profile (limit shape), as the distance $\varepsilon$ from the frozen phase (facet) is sent to zero. This has been proved so far only in exactly solvable cases, notably the classical, determinantal, 2D dimer model. In this paper we prove the validity of the Pokrovsky-Talapov law for a non-integrable 2D dimer model on the hexagonal lattice, whose Gibbs weight depends upon a weak plaquette interaction among dimers. Our proof is based on a multiscale analysis (constructive fermionic Renormalization Group), which allows us to identify two different regimes with distinct scaling properties and to explain the universality of the Pokrovsky-Talapov exponent $3/2$, in contrast with the interaction-dependent critical exponents characterizing the rough phase. The first regime, corresponding to smaller distances, is characterized by an effective quadratic dispersion relation, while the second comes with an effective linear dispersion relation, typical of Luttinger liquid behavior. As a byproduct of our construction, we control the scaling limit of the interacting dimer model uniformly in the distance from the frozen phase.
summary:
1. 针对粗糙—冻结转变，作者以构造性费米子重整化群分析蜂窝晶格上具有弱面元相互作用的非可积二维二聚体模型。
2. 证明极限高度轮廓在冻结区边缘呈距离的3/2次幂奇异性，并识别近端二次、较远端线性色散，解释该指数的普适性与粗糙相指数依赖相互作用的区别。
3. 标度极限还得到关于距冻结区距离的一致控制，将该定律的严格验证拓展至弱相互作用非可积情形，但结论不涵盖强耦合或其他晶格。

title: Stroh--Hamiltonian Framework for Modeling Incompressible Poroelastic Materials
abstract: The Stroh sextic formalism, developed by Stroh, offers a compelling framework for representing the equilibrium equations in anisotropic elasticity. This approach has proven particularly effective for studying multilayered structures and time-harmonic problems, owing to its ability to seamlessly integrate physical constraints into the analysis. By recognizing that the Stroh formalism aligns with the canonical Hamiltonian structure, this work extends its application to Biot's poroelasticity, focusing on scenarios where the solid material is incompressible and there is no fluid pressure gradient. The study introduces a novel Hamiltonian-based approach to analyze such systems, offering deeper insights into the interplay between solid incompressibility and fluid-solid coupling. A key novelty lies in the derivation of canonical equations under these constraints, enabling clearer interpretations of reversible poroelastic behavior. However, the framework assumes perfectly drained conditions and neglects dissipative effects, which limits its applicability to fully realistic scenarios involving energy loss or complex fluid dynamics. Despite this limitation, the work provides a foundational step toward understanding constrained poroelastic systems and paves the way for future extensions to more general cases, including dissipative and nonlinear regimes.
summary:
1. 针对固相不可压缩时的流固耦合，作者在无孔压梯度的二维线性Biot模型中，以乘子施加约束、以空间坐标为类时间变量，构建Stroh–哈密顿表述。
2. 推导识别了牵引和负孔压对应的共轭动量，所得正则方程重现力学平衡与均匀孔压条件，并给出哈密顿量的守恒积分。
3. 该框架可为多层介质分析提供工具，但目前仅限完全排水、无耗散情形，尚无波传播算例，孔压梯度与耗散效应仍待纳入。

title: When light travels with infinite speed: the electromagnetic loop circuits
abstract: Considering the ideal limit where the speed of light is infinite, or more precisely where the permittivity and permeability of the vaccuum are both zero, we construct a new type of electromagnetic circuit that we name an EM-loop circuit. These consist of wires having very high permittivity (E-wires) and wires having very high permeability (M-wires). These are threaded together by coils, the E-wire loops and M-wire loops. Some of the loops are terminal loops, pierced by an applied magnetic flux (for E-wire loops) or an applied displacement field (for M-wire loops) that are outside the vacuum since it does not support these fields. The response is the net flux of displacement field through a cross section of each E-wire terminal loop and the net magnetic flux through a cross section of each terminal M-wire loop. To calculate this response, the fields at the internal loops (those that are not terminal loops) are eliminated from the this http URL turns out that the response is governed by a new class of function pairs - dual Herglotz functions. Superpositions of a special class of EM-loop circuits, termed fundamental, allow us to realize any pair of dual Herglotz functions. Thus, we have obtained a complete characterization of the response functions of EM-loop circuits.
summary:
1. 针对真空介电常数与磁导率均为零时的可实现电磁响应，作者用高介电常数和高磁导率细线构建互链回路，由麦克斯韦积分方程消去内部变量，求取端口响应。
2. 证明响应由关于频率平方的对偶有理Herglotz矩阵函数完全刻画，并以含单个内部混合节点的基本回路叠加合成任意此类响应。
3. 这为理想极限下非局域超材料响应的分类提供网络基础，但非零背景参数下的漏场与波传播尚未处理，连续介质响应的完整分类仍待完成。

title: A liquid vapor phase transition in quantum statistical mechanics
abstract: We prove a liquid vapor phase transition for a quantum system of particles in the continuum. The system is the quantum version with Boltzmann statistics of the point particles model introduced in by Lebowitz, Mazel and Presutti.
summary:
1. 针对连续空间量子粒子体系能否发生液—气相变，作者研究了采用玻尔兹曼统计的Lebowitz–Mazel–Presutti点粒子模型的量子版本。
2. 作者严格证明了该模型中液—气相变的存在，为连续空间量子粒子体系的相变提供了数学确证，但摘要未给出相变条件或临界性质。
3. 这一结果为连续量子体系的相变研究提供了严格范例，但结论限于所研究的模型与统计设定，能否推广至玻色或费米体系仍待研究。

title: Dynamical Signatures of Selective Gap Closing in Multi-Dimensional Monotone Quasiperiodic Operators
abstract: We translate the spectral gap-closing criterion for multi-dimensional monotone quasiperiodic Schrödinger operators into a concrete dynamical protocol and verify it by large-scale numerics. For a non-principal label we construct a sampling function whose leading eigenfunction weight at the origin vanishes; a local bump then drives the residual weight through zero.
